purpose: Compile evidence-backed commercial opportunities into bounded money cells that can be exposed, settled, fulfilled, verified and replicated.

cell_contract.revenue_rule: No revenue claim until external buyer + settled payment + correct attribution + fulfillment + independent proof.
cell_contract.replication_rule: Only independently verified economic mechanisms may be cloned.

factory_of_factories.input: observed demand and approved commercial primitives
factory_of_factories.cell_output: a bounded commercial experiment with acquisition, settlement, fulfillment, verification and replication contracts
factory_of_factories.recursion: a verified cell can become a new template input for future compilation
